propositions: Tests entering the review-bot ASGI lifespan inherited the production 1200-second shutdown drain timeout, causing unit tests to become long-running or hang unexpectedly.

The test harness now binds SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1.0 seconds globally via _bound_review_bot_shutdown_drain autouse fixture in tests/conftest.py, preventing production timeout inheritance in ordinary tests.

Background workers (reconcile_loop and snapshot janitor) are stubbed by default in tests/unit/test_review_bot.py via _safe_review_bot_lifespan_defaults module-autouse fixture, except for tests explicitly marked with real_reconcile_loop marker.
Test-local SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS overrides (e.g., 0.1 in test_review_bot_retrigger.py) take precedence over the suite-wide 1.0-second baseline, allowing purpose-specific timeout control.
Production code remains unchanged: DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=1200 and shutdown_drain_seconds() override mechanism are preserved unchanged.
TestClient can now safely enter the real application lifespan without per-test dependency stubs and complete promptly with the 1.0-second drain timeout.
